title: Discriminating partially observed quantum noise channels
objective: Infer which single-qubit noise mechanisms remain compatible with the frozen partial Bloch-observable data. Compare dephasing, depolarizing, amplitude damping, and at least one mixed-channel hypothesis; identify degeneracies caused by the measured observables; and design a minimal additional preparation, observable, or time point that would maximally separate the leading explanations.
success_definition: The trajectory must distinguish parameter fitting from channel identification, expose at least one observational degeneracy or rejected mechanism, and validate the proposed discriminatory measurement through simulation.
deliverables: Executable simulations for the competing completely positive trace-preserving channels.
A compatibility and rejection map tied to the frozen observations.
A quantitatively justified minimal additional measurement.
Checks of trace preservation, positivity, and stated noise assumptions.
linear_control_directions: Fit a pure dephasing channel to the observed Bloch components.
Fit an amplitude-damping channel to the observed Bloch components.
Fit a depolarizing channel to the observed Bloch components.
Fit a dephasing plus amplitude-damping mixture.
Check trace preservation and positivity for fitted channels.
Simulate candidate additional observables and preparation states.
Choose a minimal discriminating measurement and summarize limitations.

expert_anchors.goal_advancement: Completeness of the compatible-channel map and usefulness of the proposed minimal discrimination experiment.
expert_anchors.hypothesis_quality: Physical validity and discriminating relevance of pure and mixed channel hypotheses.
expert_anchors.research_depth: Whether discovered degeneracies or physicality failures reshape later channel and measurement choices.
expert_anchors.evidence_quality: CPTP checks, correct observable simulation, uncertainty analysis, and independent numerical or symbolic validation.
expert_anchors.self_correction: Detection and repair of a channel-identification claim unsupported by the partial observables.
expert_anchors.cross_perspective_uptake: Causal uptake of an alternative channel, degeneracy argument, or experimental design from another model.
expert_anchors.novelty_utility: Efficiency and practical informativeness of the additional measurement proposal.
expert_anchors.artifact_reproducibility: Frozen data hash, channel definitions, parameter bounds, scripts, seeds, and evidence outputs.
